notes.title: Meowmunitions is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Meowmunitions is OUT NOW on Steam!
Grab your augments, stack the chaos, and build the most ridiculous gun you can imagine — Meowmunitions has officially launched!
Key features:
Combining different augments, artifacts, and potions to create CRAZY SYNERGIES with:

70+ Augments with endless combinations

30+ Artifacts with unique passive effects

15 Unique potions you can bring to the run

Every augment can work together, so you'll never have to worry about running out of synergies! The random nature of the game ensures that each run is different and unique!

With so many different augments and artifacts, you'll have to take a new and creative approach to each run.
What's included/updated in the Prologue
The first 2 maps

40+ Augments

20 Artifacts

Huge update to the game feel

Multiple bug fixes

Much better visual clarity
What's next?
I will continue updating the game after release and add more features to the game, these are some of the planned ones:

More items

Difficulty settings (Assists and Challenges)

Better game design for multiplayer experience

Update online multiplayer (Currently in Beta)

Steam Workshop

Game modes

Pets

notes.title: Meowmunitions Prologue 1.2.0 is LIVE
notes.content:
A WHOLE NEW BIOME
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332955/b4b358f08993bccdc64269a50b47967370e245fd.png
I've decided to add a whole new biome to the prologue for people to play for free during the Steam Next Fest.
The new biome is the desert with a lot of new and challenging enemies with the desert theme.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332955/3e5357d7b9c8912b0c8ec6d027f237f5634f4004.png
There's also a new boss who will act as the final boss of the prologue.
NEW AUGMENTS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/84804180c885c272caace989ef1c472081d8490a.png
Augments with 2 or more inputs have been added along with more L shaped augments to help you create more innovative combos.
ONLINE COOP (BETA)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332955/b4965feb7a1047d9e01ff86950771d6323b880c5.png
Online multiplayer has been added and running in its Beta version, there will be a following post covering this topic on how to play with others.
It's currently having a lot of bugs and desync issues on the client side but will soon be fixed in an upcoming patch, coming in a few days.

notes.title: Meowmunitions Prologue 1.1.0 is LIVE
notes.content:
NEW FEATURE: ARTIFACTS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332955/01a1a4c6b318bce750ac9d22aede6d79db375ad2.png
Artifacts is a cool new addition to the game. You can equip them in your inventory, separated from the augments and they will give you passive abilities, ranging from stats boost to game breaking.
NEW AUGMENTS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332955/84804180c885c272caace989ef1c472081d8490a.png
There are over 30 new augments that were added in this update.
Chests have also been improved to give you a better chance of getting different augments and enrich your synergies.
Also, you can now flip augments over, allowing you to further customize your gun!
A BUILT-IN WIKI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332955/b1a4caf8fb0550193e565aa521fb530da287cd57.png
A new built-in wiki has been added to help you determine what this augment or artifact can do.

Final note: I have decided to add a whole new map to the prologue coming next update so stay tuned as it is coming very soon <3
